test_suite_name: Registration welcome mail uses the System account identity
description: Requires a disposable seed with no player 1 and System at another ID.

tests.name: Precondition: System is not player 1 and player 1 is absent

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE lower(name) = 'system' LIMIT 1) <> 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM players WHERE player_id = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Register a player against the non-default System ID seed
Welcome mail is attributed to the System account

value.sql_int: SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE lower(name) = 'system' LIMIT 1;
